newsitem.title: ITALY: Autostrade 96 results similar to '95 - Iri.
newsitem.headline: Autostrade 96 results similar to '95 - Iri.

text.p: Italian state motorway manager Autostrade's results for 1996 are little changed from 1995 figures when it made a consolidated profit of 195.5 billion lire, the chairman of state industrial holding Iri said.

Michele Tedeschi told a lower house environment committee hearing: "There are no significant differences in the 1996 results of Autostrade in respect to those of 1995 when the parent company made a net profit of 154.6 billion and the group made a consolidated profit of 195.5 billion."
Tedeschi said: "The 1997 budget envisages a rise in production value of around six percent but an operating result in line with 1996 due mostly to a fall in net financial charges."
Net debt 1996-97 was expected to fall around 900 billion and investments expected for 1997 were around 860 billion against a preliminary investment figure for 1996 of 512 billion, he said.
